name: Hissatsu! Bokkinin!! ~Shigoku no Kairaku Chikan~
original_name: 必殺！勃起人!! ～至極の快楽痴漢～
source: The protagonist is a professional molester, who can corrupt any woman and make a sex slave out of her. This time he makes a bet with another molester—whoever creates more slaves in 30 days wins.
translation: 主人公是一名职业痴汉，能够使任何女人堕落，成为性奴隶。这一次，他与另一名痴汉打赌——三十天内，谁制造的性奴隶更多，谁就获胜。
